Delhi-Mumbai Expressway Vadodara-Mumbai section progress reviewed

Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis reviewed the progress of the Vadodara-Mumbai section of the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway. He directed officials to ensure timely completion with high construction quality. The opening date for this section has been set, with details on cost and features expected.
